metrics.name: logical_requests
metrics.definition: 각 logical_request_id를 scheduled/admitted/dispatched/terminal_response/no_response/pending로 구분한 횟수
metrics.implementation_status: PENDING; retry attempt는 새logical op 아님

metrics.name: transport_attempts
metrics.definition: 동일 logical ID의 첫 송신+재송신 횟수; protocol 내부 message는 M15

metrics.name: semantic_successes
metrics.definition: GET HIT/MISS, SET OK, DELETE OK/MISS 중 계약에 맞는 완료 응답 수
metrics.implementation_status: PENDING; 성능 success는 정합성 검사 합격을 대신하지 않음

metrics.name: dispatch_lag
metrics.definition: actual_invocation_ns - planned_invocation_ns, 같은 client clock

metrics.name: goodput
metrics.definition: M03 final 응답 시각이 관측창 안에 있는 건수 / 관측창 초
metrics.implementation_status: PENDING; fixed-N 전체값은 별도 cohort 정의

metrics.name: completion_throughput
metrics.definition: 관측창 내 final response 건수(오류 포함)/초

metrics.name: failure_fraction
metrics.definition: 해당 cohort의 no-response+오류·거절·deadline종료 logical 수 / admitted logical 수

metrics.name: retry_fraction
metrics.definition: attempt_count>1인 logical 수/admitted logical 수; retry attempt 총수도 별도

metrics.name: late_or_unresolved
metrics.definition: logical deadline 이후 응답·run 종료 시 불명확 상태를 구분. 늦은 성공은 원래 deadline 성공으로 재분류하지 않음

metrics.name: latency_service
metrics.definition: 최초 logical invocation부터 최종 response/terminal까지. 자동 retry·재발견·대기를 포함; success/failure별 분리

metrics.name: latency_scheduled
metrics.definition: planned invocation부터 terminal까지; scheduler 지연 포함
metrics.implementation_status: PENDING; client queue 지연 누락 금지

metrics.name: client_inflight
metrics.definition: admitted - logical terminal, 시각별 gauge; queue/rejected 별도

metrics.name: ack_to_apply
metrics.definition: 같은 노드에서 logical ACK 관측과 해당 request apply 사이의 시간 또는 coordinator 관측 round-trip 상한, 방법 라벨 필수
metrics.implementation_status: PENDING; cross-host 무보정 timestamp 차이 금지

metrics.name: apply_backlog
metrics.definition: accepted/ordered/committed-not-applied 별도 counts/bytes·oldest age·쓰기중단 후 drain latency

metrics.name: messages_per_op
metrics.definition: 동일 phase/time-window의 client/peer/control 메시지 delta / 성공 op수, 송신 기준

metrics.name: bytes_per_op
metrics.definition: client/peer wire byte delta/성공 op수, send/receive 분리·계측계층 기록

metrics.name: connections
metrics.definition: open/close/error·active·peak·TIME_WAIT, 지속연결과per-message연결 분리

metrics.name: cpu_cost
metrics.definition: 모든 replica의 process user+system CPU delta / 성공op수; load hosts 별도

metrics.name: storage_io
metrics.definition: KV/log별 file API·host block·device 계층의 read/write bytes/IOPS/latency/queue depth

metrics.name: host_write_amplification
metrics.definition: 같은 phase host block written bytes/logical SET+DELETE payload bytes; KV record logical bytes도 별도
metrics.implementation_status: PENDING; RF·metadata 포함, NAND WAF와 다름; 분모0=null

metrics.name: fsync_cost
metrics.definition: KV force 호출/소요시간과 stable-view force를 구분

metrics.name: cache_behavior
metrics.definition: engine/OS cache hit·miss·cache size를 계층별 수집

metrics.name: memory_gc
metrics.definition: heap/RSS/off-heap·allocation·GC pause·history/log 메모리·시간추세

metrics.name: queue_worker
metrics.definition: owner/I/O worker queue size·wait·busy·active 및 같은키 실행중 수

metrics.name: ionia_path
metrics.definition: Meta INDEX/DATA·view probe·fast/slow/fallback·stale rejection·History size/trim·1RTT-candidate vs measured RTT 경로 분리

metrics.name: hermes_path
metrics.definition: INV/ACK/VAL·INVALID age·read block·same-key wait·replay·membership epoch

metrics.name: availability
metrics.definition: fault trigger/detect/view/first success/steady recovery/catch-up 사건,1초창성공률·마지막성공부터다음성공gap

metrics.name: correctness
metrics.definition: history VIOLATION/PASS/INCONCLUSIVE·bad values·duplicate effects·checker controls

metrics.name: acked_survival
metrics.definition: overwrite없는audit key의 ACK ledger와recovery후검증 결과,missing/duplicate 분리

metrics.name: recovery_work
metrics.definition: state transfer/log replay bytes·records·복귀중service성능·catch-up target frontier

metrics.name: batch_behavior
metrics.definition: 실효batch items/bytes·fill trigger·enqueue→send 대기·inflight·batch실패

metrics.name: apply_parallelism
metrics.definition: 실제동시applyingkeys K·actual I/Oworkers W·고정stripe S·동일키순서

metrics.name: selection_adaptation
metrics.definition: replica별선택/회피/탐색·관측RTT·관측age·outstanding·외부변화후적응시간

metrics.name: batch_coupling
metrics.definition: frame하나의 지연/실패로영향받은개별요청수·HOL·cancel후점유

metrics.name: repeat_uncertainty
metrics.definition: 5개paired run별 통계·mean/sample SD/95%tCI; throughputratio와latencyreduction 분모명시

metrics.name: instrumentation_overhead
metrics.definition: 동일입력에서 observer on/off의 goodput/latency차이·observerCPU/bytes
